ADDED i1: Verifies that tag lookup is case-insensitive under htmlDefault settings, even when the JVM default Locale changes (Turkish locale, for example, uppercases 'i' d
ADDED i2: Tag.valueOf creates a fresh TagSet each call, so the two tags are equal but not identical
ADDED i3: A shared TagSet caches tags, so the same normalized name returns the identical instance
ADDED i4: Verifies the interaction between ParseSettings and Tag identity: - Tag.valueOf creates a new TagSet on every call, so identical lookups yield distinct instances
ADDED i5: Each Tag.valueOf call builds a fresh TagSet, so no instance sharing occurs here
ADDED i6: preserveCase keeps the supplied casing; htmlDefault normalises to lower-case
ADDED i7: A single shared TagSet normalises lookups with htmlDefault: same instance returned
ADDED i8: Without ParseSettings the TagSet does not normalise case, so different names → different instances
